passage: A, B, C, D, and E are seated in a straight row facing North (not necessarily in the same order). A sits to the immediate right of B. D sits at the extreme right end. C is the immediate neighbour of both B and E.

questions.question: Who sits at the extreme left end?
questions.explanation: Working out the arrangement: D is at extreme right (pos 5). A is immediately right of B, so B-A are adjacent. C is immediate neighbour of both B and E. The only valid arrangement is E-C-B-A-D. So E sits at the extreme left.

questions.question: Who sits in the middle (3rd position)?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is E-C-B-A-D (left to right). The middle (3rd) position is occupied by B.

questions.question: Who sits immediately to the left of D?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is E-C-B-A-D. D is at the extreme right (pos 5), so A (pos 4) sits immediately to the left of D.

questions.question: How many persons sit between C and A?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is E-C-B-A-D. Between C (pos 2) and A (pos 4) there is exactly one person: B (pos 3).

questions.question: Who sits immediately to the right of E?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is E-C-B-A-D. E is at pos 1 and C is at pos 2, so C sits immediately to the right of E.

passage: Six people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting in a row facing North. Q sits third from the left end. P sits to the immediate right of Q. Only two persons sit between P and T. S sits to the immediate left of R. U is not an immediate neighbour of P.

questions.question: Who sits at the extreme right end?
questions.explanation: Q is at pos 3. P is immediately right of Q, so P is at pos 4. T is 2 positions from P; T can be at pos 1 or pos 6 (2 persons between). S is immediately left of R. U is not adjacent to P. Valid arrangement: U-S-Q-P-T placed, with R next to S. One valid arrangement: U-S-Q-P-T-R (checking: R at pos 6 extreme right; S at pos 2 is immediately left of Q not R — re-evaluating). Correct arrangement: T-S-Q-P-U-R doesn't work either. With 2 persons between P(pos4) and T: T at pos 1 or pos 7(invalid). T at pos 1: T-?-Q-P-?-? with S immediately left of R; remaining U,S,R for pos 2,5,6. S-R must be adjacent: pos 5,6. U at pos 2. Arrangement: T-U-Q-P-S-R. R is at the extreme right.

questions.question: Who sits second from the left end?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is T-U-Q-P-S-R. U sits at the second position from the left end.

questions.question: How many persons sit between Q and S?
questions.explanation: Arrangement is T-U-Q-P-S-R. Q is at pos 3 and S is at pos 5. There is 1 person (P) sitting between them.

questions.question: Who is the immediate neighbour of both U and P?
questions.explanation: Arrangement is T-U-Q-P-S-R. Q (pos 3) has U (pos 2) on its left and P (pos 4) on its right, making Q the immediate neighbour of both.

questions.question: What is the position of T from the right end?
questions.explanation: Arrangement is T-U-Q-P-S-R. T is at pos 1 from the left, which means it is at the 6th position from the right end.
